The Router was too lenient on the 'No dorsal fin' checkpoint; while no fin is present, the specific 'dorsal knuckles' are not clearly resolved, only a smooth hump. I have adjusted the status to reflect that the knuckles are ambiguous rather than clearly present. artifact_review: The Router identified texture anomalies in the water (smudging) and synthetic background blur. The perceptual_quality_auditor found no graphics-level distortions (noise/compression), which contradicts the Router's finding of 'smudging'—this suggests the issue is generative (physics simulation failure) rather than post-processing artifact. The topology_boundary_auditor confirmed a high-confidence mask (0.98), indicating the subject-background separation is structurally sound despite the water physics issues. The fine_grained_classifier ranked 'leatherback turtle' higher than 'grey whale', likely due to the callosities resembling turtle shell texture or the lack of definitive whale features (blowholes/flukes) in the crop. This low semantic certainty combined with the water physics artifacts warrants a lower artifact score than the formula suggests.
